author: Root binding and cleanup clarifications over Claude draft; no physical networking claim
scope: Networking step 001 (STEP-001.md): guest BSD stack, lo0, UDP/TCP loopback, a feth pair over BPF with kernel ARP and IPv4 output, and utun out/in. Base mode only for the first boot. No NIC, firmware, Wi-Fi, USB, PCIe or macOS kext.

required.N1_binding: Same complete kernel/source.patch/libSystem9fc/native input/passive tracer as trackpad002. RAM318files =316base + two exact Claude buildfiles and one replacement /usr/bin/darwin-desktop-test compatibility wrapper. Host sends exact challenge plus its existing fixed quoted-CR desktop launcher and seals; wrapper validates nonce and execs only darwin-net-probe-test in base mode. No host logic change or new bootargs.
required.N2_decoder_pass: integrations/puredarwin/m1-network/decode/decode_net.py, at its reviewed hash, returns verdict PASS for the captured console and nonce, in mode base. That means every BASE_REQUIRED step is pass, failed=0, the done counts match, the status marker has rc=0, and the return block shows Darwin, arm64, the release and DL25_NET_END.
required.N3_link_evidence: feth_frame_a2b and feth_frame_b2a are pass with b_ipackets_delta >= 1 and a_ipackets_delta >= 1. feth_arp_request and feth_ipv4_out are pass. utun_out and utun_in are pass.
required.N4_cleanup: feth_destroy and utun_close reportpass AND an actual untruncated after-interface listing is present (listed<24, noerrno, complete indexed entries), with neither created feth name nor created utun name present. utun_close output is unconditional in source, so it alone is not proof of successful close or absence. Do not infer cleanup from that line.
required.N5_recovery: One bounded cycle. Capture finalized, one reset at most, new verified Linux, latch absent, controller lock free.
required.N6_scope: No step result is inferred from a missing line. A decoder FAIL stays a failure. The result is never described as physical networking, external reachability, Wi-Fi or Skywalk-native operation (that last needs a separate --skywalk boot and its own criteria).

not_claimed: DHCP, DNS or routing beyond the probe's own subnets
Skywalk native netif operation (base mode uses BSD-mode feth)
